title: SCHC Version 3 Rule 1 and 6 address prefixes diverge across Rust Python and spec
description: Rust generic descriptors use fd00::/64 for Rules 1 and 6, Python and Rust whole-packet codec use the canonical Yggdrasil 0200::/8 model, while spec/03 still describes mesh /64 compression. Align descriptors and normative spec with 0200::/8 and test generic descriptors against whole-packet vectors.
notes: UPDATE: Per decision on worker6-vdon, LICHEN is adopting full Yggdrasil AddrForKey compatibility. Address space is now 0200::/7 (both 02xx and 03xx), not 0200::/8. SCHC Rules 1 and 6 MUST accept both first-byte values. This bead is blocked until the Yggdrasil address implementations land (worker6-yjg6, worker6-4tji, worker6-4bju, worker6-lqzm).
